original_ai_output.title_zh: 据ACLED报告：恐怖分子在德尔加杜角三省区日益针对平民
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 据独立冲突登记项目ACLED最新报告，伊斯兰国莫桑比克分支（ISM）在8月和9月期间日益针对莫桑比克南部德尔加杜角省莫辛布瓦-达普拉亚、穆伊敦贝和马科米亚三个地区的平民。报告称，ISM在莫辛布瓦-达普拉亚收紧安全措施，限制商业和人道活动，并可能通过绑架外国人获取赎金。10月初，三名此前在尼亚萨省被绑架的人质在支付320万梅蒂卡尔赎金后获释。

location.raw_text: districts of Mocimboa da Praia, Muidumbe, and Macomia, in the southern Mozambican province of Cabo Delgado

key_facts.fact: 据ACLED报告，伊斯兰国莫桑比克分支在8月和9月日益针对德尔加杜角省三个地区的平民
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Islamic State Mozambique (ISM) has increasingly targeted civilians in the districts of Mocimboa da Praia, Muidumbe, and Macomia, in the southern Mozambican province of Cabo Delgado over the months of August and September.

key_facts.fact: 报告称ISM在莫辛布瓦-达普拉亚收紧安全措施，限制商业和人道活动
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the terrorists have been tightening security measures in Mocimboa da Praia, constraining commercial and humanitarian activity.

key_facts.fact: 10月4日，三名此前于9月3日在尼亚萨省狩猎营地被绑架的人质在支付320万梅蒂卡尔赎金后获释
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: On 4 October, three hostages whom ISM had abducted during the 3 September raid on a hunting camp in Niassa were released. This was in return for a ransom of 3.2 million meticais (roughly $53,000 at the time).

key_facts.fact: 据国际移民组织，8月和9月德尔加杜角省的袭击导致700多人逃离
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: According to the International Organization for Migration (IOM), over August and September, attacks in Cabo Delgado (Litandacua on the N380, and at Pangane on the coast) prompted over 700 people to flee.

uncertainties: 报告内容基于ACLED单一来源，尚未获得其他独立来源交叉验证
ISM是否会在该地区长期驻留尚属推测
未来针对外国人的绑架风险为报告评估，尚未证实
